notes.title: Patch Notes for August 27th 2025
notes.content:
[list][*][p]Removed all AI generated content from the game and replaced with real, existing artwork[/p][/*][*][p]Added new SFX to the Husk[/p][/*][*][p]Added reworked and improved SFX with reverb in the later sections of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, if you were reading a note and you got killed, the note would permanently stay on screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could pick up items from the safe without inputting the password[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a door’s animation wasn’t properly synced up with the audio[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the mixing for several different sounds across the whole game[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

tags.feature: Removed all AI generated content from the game and replaced with real, existing artwork
Added new SFX to the Husk
Added reworked and improved SFX with reverb in the later sections of the game

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where, if you were reading a note and you got killed, the note would permanently stay on screen
Fixed a bug where you could pick up items from the safe without inputting the password
Fixed an issue where a door’s animation wasn’t properly synced up with the audio

notes.title: Patch Notes for January 20th 2025
notes.content:
- Fixed movement bug caused by third party's virtual Joystick program
- Fixed "Duly Noted" achievement

notes.title: Patch Notes for January 18th 2025
notes.content:

- Fixed typos.
